rules.description: One direction records repeated fold-to-partner wins in a rolling event-time window.
rules.duplicate_semantics: same hand and revision with identical inputs re-emits deterministic evidence
rules.stale_semantics: lower revisions do not mutate state or emit evidence
rules.correction_semantics: a higher revision replaces that hand inside the retained horizon; current and future evaluations use the replacement without retroactively deleting immutable evidence
rules.late_event_semantics: an unseen hand older than watermark minus allowed lateness does not mutate rule state or emit evidence
